text:
eve-customer: Hey team — our weekly usage export (CSV) is missing rows for 2025-02-28 and 2025-03-01. Dashboard shows tokens for those days but the CSV has zeros, which caused an invoice mismatch. org_id: org_12345, export_job_id: export_9876. Can you investigate?

ben-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl/HTTP call you used and a tiny CSV snippet? Also what timezone are you using for start/end?

eve-customer: curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/exports?org=org_12345&start=2025-02-24&end=2025-03-02' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -o usage-wk.csv
CSV snippet:
"date,org_id,model,tokens_in,tokens_out,total_tokens"
"2025-02-27,org_12345,gptx,12000,300,12300"
"2025-02-28,org_12345,gptx,0,0,0"
"2025-03-01,org_12345,gptx,0,0,0"

ben-support: Thanks. Can you confirm the invoice number that's showing the higher total? Also we'll run a quick check on ingestion/backfill.

eve-customer: Invoice INV-2025-0315 shows +$312 vs what CSV indicates. Happy to share access if needed.

david-telemetry: Checking ingestion/aggregation for org_12345 now. I can see a short aggregation pipeline stall at 2025-02-28 23:50 UTC — looks like a retention job touched the same partitions and caused the daily aggregator to skip two partition windows. Backfill job etl-backfill-20250301-42 ran but failed on shards 3 and 7 due to a temp DB lock.

carla-billing: If backfill recovers and token counts increase, we'll need org-level variance calc to decide credit. Please flag if tokens added > 1% or dollars > $50.

ben-support: Repro steps for our side: 1) query /v1/usage/summary?org=org_12345&start=2025-02-28&end=2025-03-01 to compare aggregated totals; 2) check export job status GET /v1/usage/exports/export_9876; 3) tail backend logs for aggregator: /var/log/usage-agg/2025-02-28.log (sample grep below).
```
# sample tail
2025-02-28T23:49:58Z INFO aggregator: window close 2025-02-28T23:00:00Z
2025-02-28T23:50:02Z ERROR retention: lock conflict on partition-7
2025-03-01T00:00:12Z INFO aggregator: skip window 2025-02-28T23:00:00Z (locked)
```

ben-support: I'm going to open a backfill run and re-run export once it's complete.

metrics-bot: Backfill job etl-backfill-20250301-42 restarted by david-telemetry at 2025-03-03T02:15:10Z. Status: running.

david-telemetry: Backfill completed successfully for all shards at 2025-03-03T02:48:30Z. I verified delta tokens for org_12345: +35,420 tokens across the two days. The root cause was a retention job that briefly acquired DB locks during our hourly aggregation cutoff — edge-case race with DST boundary handling.

ben-support: I re-exported the CSV after the backfill: new file at https://S3.redwood/exports/export_9876-retried.csv — can you pull and check the rows? For future exports, set include_partial_day=true to include windows that might straddle cutoff. Also we pushed a small fix to lock ordering to avoid lock conflicts during cutoff.

eve-customer: Downloaded and checked — the new CSV shows 2025-02-28 and 2025-03-01 rows with tokens: 2025-02-28 total_tokens 21,300; 2025-03-01 total_tokens 14,120. Dashboard and CSV now match.

carla-billing: Based on the +35,420 tokens, that's $0.00xx; invoice INV-2025-0315 variance is $312 because earlier CSV had omitted some higher-cost calls (model tiered). We'll issue a credit note CN-2025-0318 for $312 and adjust the monthly usage summary. I'll DM the customer with details.

eve-customer: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Can you also confirm whether this could happen again around month boundaries?

david-telemetry: We've deployed lock-order fix and added an alert for >5% missing tokens in a daily export window. Also improved backfill retry for DB lock errors. Should be much less likely.

ben-support: Closing loop: we've re-run the backfill, re-exported CSV, billing will issue credit, and we deployed a fix. Please reopen if you see any more discrepancies. :thumbsup:

eve-customer: All good on our end, thanks everyone! :rocket:
